description: K₂NaCa₂TiSi₇HO₂₀ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent K sites. In the first K site, K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.75-3.38 Å. In the second K site, K is bonded in a 11-coordinate geometry to one H and ten O atoms. The K-H bond length is 2.82 Å. There are a spread of K-O bond distances ranging from 2.81-3.35 Å. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.79 Å. There are two inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra, corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four CaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 58°. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.40 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O atoms to form CaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with four CaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.24-2.40 Å. Ti is bonded to six O atoms to form TiO₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₆ octahedra, corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one TiO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 58°. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.13 Å. There are seven inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one TiO₆ octahedra, corners with three CaO₆ octahedra, and corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 25-64°. There are two shorter (1.60 Å) and two longer (1.65 Å) Si-O bond lengths. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 55-67°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.60-1.65 Å.
